James / Neha — short technical note and what I plan to attach tomorrow.

Context: on 2026-02-02 we saw a transient spike in authentication attempts from a small set of client IPs associated with token replay. No customer data was exfiltrated and no production keys were compromised; containment occurred within ~18 minutes. We ran a targeted telemetry extract and applied a two-stage redaction: PII removal + token/identifier truncation.

Planned deliverables (2026-02-13 EOD):
- postmortem-20260202.pdf (4-page sanitized RCA + timeline)
- redacted-telemetry-sample.json (10 events, redacted fields)
- s3-access-audit.csv (access log rows relevant to the event window)

James — attaching the sanitized packet we discussed. Summary below and quick clarifications for your reviewers.

Executive summary:
- Event: transient authentication spike on 2026-02-02. Containment: automated rate-limiting + ephemeral token revocation; no evidence of data exfiltration.
- Root cause: automated credential stuffing against legacy token-exchange endpoint; mitigated by a config change that hardened token TTL and added anomaly throttling.
- Impact: brief service throttling for a subset of API tokens; no customer-visible data loss.

Attachments included (sanitized): postmortem-20260202.pdf (RCA + timeline), redacted-telemetry-sample.json (10 redacted events), s3-access-audit.csv (relevant rows), plus the IRP overview and telemetry index previously shared.

Access & next steps:
- Link to artifact bundle: https://drive.redwood.example.com/s/fincomp-irp-bundle (read-only; expires 2026-03-13).
- If FinComp requires a full SIG evidence export (unredacted logs), please confirm an NDA scope and access window; we will schedule a short onboarding call for your reviewers.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 30-min review with your SOC to walk through the artifacts. Proposed times: Mon 02/16 10:00-11:00 or Tue 02/17 14:00-15:00 PT.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference
